message: Last week, we had an unexpected power outage, and instead of letting it get me down, I decided to turn it into a cozy family night! I grabbed my trusty flashlight and a few power banks for our devices, and we huddled together with some snacks. We played games and shared stories by lantern light—it felt like our own little adventure! It reminded me that even in the dark, there's a chance to shine with warmth and connection. What’s your favorite way to make the best of a blackout?
